Annie

the Dark Child

Annie is one of the simplest champions in the game, and still one of the scariest. Every fourth spell stuns, and her bear Tibbers drops on the enemy team with a huge burst. Perfect for new players who want to learn mid lane and still make big plays.

When to pick Annie

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Risky. Her short range gets punished by long-range mages, so she's better picked after you see the enemy mid.

Pick into

  • Melee mids and assassins who have to walk into her stun, like Yasuo, Talon and Qiyana
  • Scaling mages who are weak early, like Ryze, Azir and Cassiopeia
  • Teams that like to group up: a Tibbers stun on three or four people wins the fight
  • Squishy carries she can burst before they react, like Jinx or Xerath

Avoid into

  • Long-range poke mages who hit her from outside her range, like Zoe and Vel'Koz
  • Divers who are tanky enough to survive her burst, like Diana
  • Spread-out teams with lots of tanks where her single combo isn't enough
  • Teams with Cleanse or Quicksilver on every carry

Great teammates

AmumuAmumu's ultimate stuns the whole team so Tibbers lands on everyone.
MalphiteMalphite's ultimate knocks the enemy team up in a clump, the perfect moment to flash in with Tibbers.
LeonaLeona's chain of crowd control keeps targets still for Annie's flash-Tibbers combo.

Your team needs: Pick Annie when your team has other engage or wombo-combo ultimates, so her Tibbers stun can start or finish fights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Very easy to learn: no skill shots, and a point-and-click Q
  • Guaranteed stun every fourth spell gives her reliable kill pressure
  • Tibbers with a stun can win teamfights by itself
  • Q refunds its mana when it kills a minion, so she can farm almost for free

Weaknesses

  • Short range, so long-range mages can poke her out of lane
  • Very little mobility: easy to gank if she's pushed up
  • Enemies can see when her stun is ready, so they play around it
  • Falls behind if her burst can't kill her target

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: with stun up, Q + W + Ignite hurts badly. Threaten an all-in.
  • Level 6: Tibbers with stun is one of the strongest level 6 burst combos in the game.
  • First item (Malignance): lower ultimate cooldown means more Tibbers and more kills.
  • Two items (Stormsurge): you can delete squishy champions in one combo.

Top tips

  • Last-hit with Q every time it's up: it refunds its mana on a kill.
  • Use E on yourself to stack the stun without spending mana on damage.
  • The enemy can see when your stun is ready. Fake it by walking forward, then back, to waste their time.
  • Flash + stunning Tibbers on three or more enemies is game-winning. Always look for it.
  • Shield your ally ADC or jungler with E during fights.
  • Tibbers keeps attacking and burning enemies after he lands, so drop him where the fight will stay, not at its edge.
